name: cobol-replace-pseudo-text-only
body: replace matches pseudo-text pairs, including multi-line, period-bearing and empty BY pseudo-text, and honours REPLACE OFF; COPY REPLACING word, literal and identifier operands reach it already wrapped as pseudo-text by the preprocessor. A REPLACE statement starts at any token spelled REPLACE. Limit: a REPLACE statement accepts pseudo-text operands only, and REPLACE used as a data name would be misread. Upgrade when a dialect allows non-pseudo-text REPLACE operands or a corpus uses REPLACE as a name.
